subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Two-Factor Authentication Explained
description: A fast breakdown of Two-Factor Authentication Explained for builders.

hook.text: A hacker has your password. They still can't get in because they don't have your phone.

buildup.text: Two-factor authentication requires something you know (password) and something you have (phone).

discovery.text: Enabling 2FA blocks over 99% of automated attacks, even if your password is compromised.

twist.text: SMS-based 2FA can be bypassed with SIM swapping. App-based authenticators are much safer.

climax.text: Most major accounts offer 2FA for free. Turning it on takes under two minutes.

punchline.text: One extra step stops 99% of hackers. That's a good trade.

quiz.question: What is more secure than SMS-based two-factor authentication?
